actions.noneDescription: No action will be assigned to this button.
actions.autoAttackDescription: Your character automatically attacks the selected target while it is in range.
actions.healDescription: Use a bandage to heal yourself. If you are not injured and another character is selected, the bandage is used on them.
actions.healingPotionDescription: Use a health potion from inventory when injured. The strongest available potion is always used.
actions.manaPotionDescription: Use a mana potion from inventory when mana is not full. The strongest available potion is always used.
actions.equipStoredWeaponsDescription: Switch between primary and secondary stored weapon. If you are holding a completely different weapon, the primary one will be equipped.
actions.campingDescription: Try to light a fire if it's possible in this place and you have some wood in inventory. You can rest and cook food on the fire.
